name: How-to / Tutorial
description: Step-by-step guide: what you'll need, the steps, and a few tips.

blocks.html: Say what the reader will be able to do by the end, and roughly how long it takes. One short paragraph.
List the kit, accounts, or starting point. If there are prerequisites, name them here so nobody gets stuck halfway.
Step 1. Replace with the first step. Write it as an instruction — one action per step.
Step 2. Replace with the next step. Keep the order honest — write it the way you'd actually do it.
The small things that save time or trouble — the bit you only learn by doing it once and getting it wrong.
